statement:
Build a Tetris game as a single static HTML file named `index.html` in the repo root.

Requirements:
- A playfield 10 columns wide and 20 rows tall. Row 0 is the top row.
- The seven tetrominoes: `I`, `O`, `T`, `S`, `Z`, `J`, `L`. Give each one its own colour.
- A piece spawns at the top and falls one row at a time under gravity.
- When a piece can no longer fall, it locks in place and the next piece spawns.
- The player can move the falling piece left and right, soft drop it (one row down), and hard
  drop it. A hard drop sends the piece straight down to the lowest position it can reach and

title: Build a Tetris game as a single static HTML file
statement: Deliver a complete Tetris game in one static HTML file with a 10×20 playfield, seven tetrominoes, gravity, movement, line clearing, score/level/lines tracking, and DOM-only rendering.
acceptance: Single index.html file in repo root, inline CSS and JS, no external dependencies
Playfield is 10 columns × 20 rows, all 200 cells have data-testid='cell' with data-row, data-col, data-filled, data-piece attributes
Seven tetrominoes (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L) each with distinct CSS color class
Piece spawns at top and falls one row per gravity step
Locked piece triggers next piece spawn; new piece with no room sets 'over' status
Player can move left/right, soft drop (one row), and hard drop (instant lock)
Score, level, and lines cleared displayed and tracked with initial values 0, 1, 0
All pieces rendered as DOM elements with CSS colors, never canvas or image
Game works when opened directly from filesystem, no network requests
Rendering is synchronous; DOM reflects state immediately after every change
sub_requirements: Playfield with 200 cells properly indexed and attributed
Player controls: left, right, soft drop, hard drop

title: Add rotation, and settle how a piece locks.
statement:
Add rotation, and settle how a piece locks.

- The player can rotate the falling piece clockwise. Add `"rotateCW"` to the actions
  `window.__tetris.input(action)` accepts.
- A rotation must never put the piece outside the board or on top of a locked cell. If the
  rotated shape does not fit where it is, the game may shift it sideways to make room. If
  nothing works, refuse the rotation and leave the piece exactly as it was.

Locking rule — this is a decision, keep it for the rest of the project:
- A gravity step moves the falling piece down one row. If it cannot move down, that step
  counts...

title: Rotation and piece locking rules
statement: The player can rotate the falling piece clockwise, and the piece locks according to a delay mechanism based on gravity steps and restarts.
acceptance: rotateCW action is accepted by window.__tetris.input(action)
Rotation tries in-place then shifted 1-2 columns sideways; refuses if no fit
Gravity step that cannot move piece down counts one lock delay tick
Piece locks on the second lock delay tick
Left/right move while resting restarts lock delay, up to 3 times per piece
Hard drop locks piece immediately with no delay
Up arrow sends rotateCW action
Lock restart count persists when piece falls further
sub_requirements: Implement clockwise rotation with sideways kick
Implement lock delay restart on lateral moves (3 times maximum per piece)

title: Add line clears and scoring.
statement:
Add line clears and scoring.

- When a piece locks, every full row is removed and everything above it drops down.
- Count the rows removed in `lines` and show it.

Scoring model — this is a decision, keep it for the rest of the project:
- Points for a clear depend on how many rows go at once:
  1 row = 100, 2 rows = 300, 3 rows = 500, 4 rows = 800.
- That number is multiplied by the current level.
- Soft drop scores 1 point for each cell the piece moves down under the player's control.
- Hard drop scores 2 points for each cell the piece drops.

The reason for the table: clearing rows together ...

title: Add line clears and scoring
statement: When a piece locks, every full row is removed and everything above it drops down; count rows removed and award points based on rows cleared at once, multiplied by level, plus soft-drop and hard-drop bonuses.
acceptance: Full rows are removed when a piece locks
Rows above cleared rows drop down
Lines cleared counter shows the count
Clearing 1, 2, 3, or 4 rows at once scores 100, 300, 500, or 800 points respectively
Clear points are multiplied by the current level before the clear
Soft drop scores 1 point only when the player's down press actually moves the piece
Hard drop scores 2 points for each row the piece falls before locking
sub_requirements: Implement line clearing logic that removes full rows
Implement scoring for rows cleared at once

title: Two additions.
statement:
Two additions.

Next-piece preview:
- Show the next **three** upcoming pieces, soonest first.
- `data-testid="next-piece"` — the preview container.
- `data-testid="next-piece-item"` — one upcoming piece in the preview, in order, each carrying

- Colour-code each preview piece by its type, using the colour that piece has on the board.

Game over:
- When a newly spawned piece has nowhere to go, the game ends.
- `data-testid="game-over"` — shown when the game is over.
- `window.__tetris.getState().status` becomes `"gameover"`.
- Once the game is over, gravity steps ...

title: Next-piece preview and game-over state
statement: Show the next three upcoming pieces in order and end the game when a spawned piece cannot fit.
acceptance: Preview container has data-testid="next-piece"
Each preview piece has data-testid="next-piece-item" and data-piece attribute with piece type
Three upcoming pieces displayed, soonest first
Preview pieces colour-coded by type using board colours
Game ends when newly spawned piece has nowhere to fit
Game-over overlay has data-testid="game-over"
window.__tetris.getState().status becomes "gameover" on game end
Gravity steps and player actions do nothing when game is over
sub_requirements: Next-piece preview showing three upcoming pieces

title: Players are complaining about the down key.
statement:
Players are complaining about the down key.

"I slam a piece down with the down arrow and it locks under my fingers before I can nudge it.
Tapping left or right at the bottom gives me a moment to think, but tapping down doesn't."

Fix that: a soft drop on a piece that is already resting on the stack should buy the player
the same breathing room a sideways move buys.

title: Soft drop breathing room on resting piece
statement: A soft drop on a piece that is already resting on the stack should buy the player the same breathing room a sideways move buys, instead of locking the piece.
acceptance: Soft drop on a resting piece restarts the lock delay instead of counting a tick
Soft drop uses the same MAX_LOCK_RESETS budget (3 restarts) as sideways moves
Soft drop scores nothing when performed on a resting piece
After the restart limit is exhausted, soft drop does nothing and the timer finishes the lock

title: Three upcoming pieces is too much information — it turns the game into a plannin...
statement:
Three upcoming pieces is too much information — it turns the game into a planning exercise and
it crowds the panel. Show only the next piece.

Keep the colour-coding in the preview. That part works.

title: Show only next piece in preview
statement: The preview panel must display only the next upcoming piece instead of three, keeping colour-coding.
acceptance: Preview panel displays only the next piece
Colour-coding of the preview piece is retained
PREVIEW variable changed from 3 to 1
Fixed piece order from test controls still plays out in full

title: Two additions.
statement:
Two additions.

Levels and speed:
- The level starts at 1 and goes up by one for every 10 lines cleared. It never goes down.
- The higher the level, the faster gravity runs. The interval between gravity steps, in
  milliseconds, is `max(100, 1000 - (level - 1) * 100)`.
- `window.__tetris.getState()` gains `dropInterval` — that interval in milliseconds.
- `window.__tetris.tick(n)` is unchanged: it always advances exactly n gravity steps, whatever
  the level is.
- Add `window.__tetris.setLevel(n)` — sets the current level to n, for testing. Levelling from
  lines carries on from there, and the ...

title: Levels and hold
statement: Add level progression with gravity speed scaling and a hold mechanism for piece storage.
acceptance: Level starts at 1 and increases by one for every 10 lines cleared, never decreases
Gravity interval in milliseconds is max(100, 1000 - (level - 1) * 100)
window.__tetris.getState() returns dropInterval field with current gravity interval
window.__tetris.tick(n) advances exactly n gravity steps regardless of level
window.__tetris.setLevel(n) sets level to n for testing, levelling continues from there
One hold slot stores a piece when 'hold' action invoked
Holding swaps current falling piece with held piece, or stores current if empty
Held piece enters at spawn position when brought back
Only one hold per piece until piece locks
'hold' added to window.__tetris.input(action) accepted actions

title: Bug report from a player:
statement:
Bug report from a player:

"I've been grinding at level 5. I set up a well, dropped an I piece down it and took four rows
at once — and it scored me less than the two-row clears I'd been getting, twice over. Four
rows in one go is the hardest thing in the game. It can't be worth less than doing it the
easy way."

Reproduce it and fix it.

title: Two additions.
statement:
Two additions.

Ghost piece:
- Show where the falling piece would land, as an outline at the bottom of the board.
- Ghost cells carry `data-ghost="true"`. They are not filled cells — leave their
  `data-filled` as `"false"`.
- `window.__tetris.getState()` gains `ghost` — the array of `[row, col]` cells the ghost
  occupies.

Pause:
- `data-testid="pause-btn"` — a button that pauses and resumes.
- `data-testid="paused-indicator"` — shown while the game is paused.
- `window.__tetris.getState().status` becomes `"paused"` while paused.
- Add `"pause"` to the actions `window.__tetris.input(action)`...

title: Ghost piece and pause feature
statement: Show a ghost piece outline at landing position and add pause/resume functionality to the game.
acceptance: Ghost cells rendered with outline in piece colour, data-ghost="true", data-filled="false"
getState().ghost returns array of [row, col] landing cells
Pause button with data-testid="pause-btn" toggles pause state
Paused indicator with data-testid="paused-indicator" shown while paused
getState().status becomes "paused" while paused
input("pause") action toggles pause; also responds to P and Escape keys
During pause, gravity steps and player actions do nothing
Lock delay and restart ticks preserved across pause; resume continues with remaining time
sub_requirements: Ghost piece visualization showing where falling piece would land
Pause/resume with preserved gravity timing to prevent lock delay abuse

title: Final pass.
statement:
Final pass.

Add keyboard controls:
- Left and Right arrows move the piece.
- Down arrow soft drops.
- Up arrow rotates clockwise.
- Space hard drops.
- C holds.
- P pauses and resumes.
- R starts a new game.

Add `data-testid="restart-btn"` — a button that starts a new game: empty board, score 0,
lines 0, level 1, running.

Then verify that nothing we built in earlier steps has broken, and fix anything that has.

title: Final pass: keyboard controls and restart button
statement: Add keyboard controls for Tetris gameplay and a visible restart button that resets the game to empty board, score 0, lines 0, level 1, running state.
acceptance: Left and Right arrow keys move the piece
Down arrow soft drops
Up arrow rotates clockwise
Space hard drops
C holds the piece
P pauses and resumes
R starts a new game
Restart button with data-testid="restart-btn" starts a new game
Game state after restart: empty board, score 0, lines 0, level 1, running
Modifier keys (Ctrl, Cmd, Alt) do not trigger game actions
sub_requirements: Add restart button with correct data-testid
Verify no regression in earlier features
